text.zh_cn:
# 饥饿如深渊
饥渴会侵蚀不死人，也会侵蚀你。
- 耕种 [item:minecraft:carrot] 与 [item:minecraft:potato]
- 熟食优于生食：*炖菜* 与 *烤肉* 回复更多
- 常备 [item:minecraft:golden_apple]，危机时刻的秘药
> 空腹挑战强敌者，终将化为薪柴。
text.en_us:
# Hunger, the Abyss
Hunger gnaws at the undead, and it gnaws at you.
- Farm [item:minecraft:carrot] and [item:minecraft:potato]
- Cooked food beats raw: *stew* and *roast meat* restore more
- Keep [item:minecraft:golden_apple] as a last resort
> One who faces a foe on an empty stomach becomes kindling.
